headline: Tutor Perini (TPC) Lands $69.5 Million Death Valley Water Rehab Contract
summary: Tutor Perini (NYSE:TPC) subsidiary Perini Management Services Inc. has been awarded a significant contract to rehabilitate water and wastewater treatment systems at Death Valley National Park. The project involves upgrades to critical water infrastructure that supports park operations and visitor services. The contract adds to Tutor Perini's construction backlog and contributes to future revenue visibility from government work. For readers tracking how infrastructure and utility upgrades...
